content_sections.heading: MPKV Job Description
content_sections.text: Candidates selected for Senior Research Fellow and Laboratory Assistant positions will perform all duties, responsibilities that will be assigned to him/her by the PI/Co PI/Superior Authority as per the requirement of the project. Regular attendance must be ensured by the concerned PI by keeping the attendance register. Research work done by the Senior Research Fellow / Laboratory Assistant will be the property of the university and the Senior Research Fellow / Laboratory Assistant will have no control or right on the same. The contribution in research work can accordingly be acknowledged/included in the research papers after the prior permission from PI.

content_sections.text: Qualification required: M. Sc. in Agril Biotechnology. Experience required: Minimum three to four year experience in plant tissue culture laboratory/ Molecular Biology laboratory. Age limit: Minimum will be 21 years and maximum age 45 years. Pay: Rs. 35,000 (Fixed pay). Qualification required: Bachelor degree in Agril. Biotechnology / Agriculture / Horticulture. Experience required: Minimum one year experience in plant tissue culture laboratory/ Molecular Biology laboratory. Age limit: Minimum will be 21 years and maximum age 45 years. Pay: Rs. 18,000 (Fixed pay).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Senior Research Fellow, 1 Laboratory Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Page 3 of this PDF) and send it to Officer Incharge, State Level Biotechnology Centre, MPKV, Rahuri - 413722, Dist. Ahilyanagar, by by post, to reach by 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum will be 21 years and maximum age 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 35,000 (Fixed pay) for Senior Research Fellow, Rs. 18,000 (Fixed pay) for Laboratory Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Agril Biotechnology / Bachelor degree in Agril. Biotechnology / Agriculture / Horticulture. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Regular attendance must be ensured by the concerned PI by keeping the attendance register. Selected candidate will have to work at State Level Biotechnology Centre, MPKV, Rahuri for entire term as full-time worker.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who canvass will be disqualified.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview by Selection Committee. The eligible candidate will be interviewed by Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for 6 months and likely to be extended further based on availability of budget.
